_comment: MAIS CAR — Cloudflare R2 lifecycle rules (2026-09-15). Apply via `wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle put maiscar-media --file r2-lifecycle.json` OR the Cloudflare dashboard (R2 → maiscar-media → Settings → Object lifecycle rules). Every rule is scoped to a key prefix so a mistake in one bucket doesn't wipe another. Keep 'Standard' storage class (no Infrequent Access — R2 Standard is already cheapest for the write-once/read-a-few pattern of a published Reel).

rules._comment: Published Reels' MP4 + cover live 30 days on R2. Meta's own CDN owns the copy that viewers actually see; R2 only exists as the ingest URL. 30 days is enough for reprocessing / audits.
Pre-publish render artifacts (draft MP4s, intermediate clips) wiped after 24h. Anything worth keeping was moved to reels/<id>/ before that.
A render that crashed mid-upload leaves an incomplete multipart. Kill after 24h so R2 storage doesn't accumulate ghost parts.
